# YTDL - YouTube Video & Audio Downloader
> Free, fast, and secure online YouTube video downloader, YouTube Shorts downloader, YouTube to MP3 converter, and full-resolution thumbnail grabber.

## Core Features
- **YouTube Video Downloader**: Download YouTube videos in 4K, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, MP4, and WebM.
- **YouTube Shorts Downloader**: Save vertical 9:16 Shorts with crystal-clear audio and zero watermarks.
- **YouTube to MP3 Converter**: Rip and extract audio streams in 320kbps, 192kbps, and 128kbps MP3 and M4A.
- **YouTube Thumbnail Grabber**: Download maximum-resolution cover thumbnails (1080p maxresdefault, hqdefault).
- **Zero Software Required**: Runs directly in any web browser on desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux) and mobile (iOS, Android).
- **100% Free**: Unlimited downloads, no account registration, no credit card required.

## How It Works
1. Copy any public YouTube or YouTube Shorts video link.
2. Paste the link into the search box on YTDL and click "Download Now".
3. Select your desired resolution, file size, or format (MP4 or MP3) and download instantly.
